name: Canonical Tag Implementation
summary: Set up canonical tags on your website to prevent duplicate content issues and consolidate SEO value.
description: Implementing canonical tags is a crucial step in optimizing your website for search engines. This project focuses on setting up canonical tags across your website to address duplicate content issues that can dilute your SEO efforts. By defining the preferred version of a webpage, we will ensure that search engines understand which page to index and rank, thereby consolidating SEO value. The process involves a thorough audit of your existing pages to identify duplicates, followed by the strategic placement of canonical tags in the HTML header of each relevant page. Additionally, we will provide a report detailing the changes made and recommendations for ongoing SEO practices. This project is designed to enhance your site's visibility and improve its overall search engine ranking.
deliverables: Audit report identifying duplicate content issues (document)
Implementation of canonical tags on specified webpages (work)

The process will involve analyzing your current URL structure, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing changes that enhance user experience and search engine crawlability. By optimizing your URLs, we aim to increase click-through rates and drive more organic traffic to your site. This project will deliver a comprehensive report detailing the changes made, along with recommendations for future URL management, ensuring your website remains competitive in search results.
deliverables: Analysis of current URL structure (document)
List of recommended URL changes (document)
Implementation of optimized URLs (work)
Final report on URL optimization outcomes (document)
